bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
compose="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$compose" || exit 60
grep -q 'bug_report_recipient:' "$compose" || exit 61
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 62
cid="${ids[0]}"
docker exec "$cid" test -e /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient || exit 63
docker exec "$cid" test -f /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient || exit 64
docker exec "$cid" test -r /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient || exit 65
echo REPORT_SECRET_MOUNT_READABLE=PASS
